newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil OKs opening banking to foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Brazil OKs opening banking to foreigners.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) approved a proposal opening up the country's banking sector to foreign banks.

The CMN recommended that a proposal be sent to President Fernando Henrique Cardoso asking him to revoke a presidential decree which restricts foreigners from participating in the Brazilian banking sector, a document approved by the CMN said.
Officials were due to explain the proposal at a news conference later today.
The CMN was also slated to discuss the small print of a decree converting state banks into development agencies.
An official said the details also were approved by the CMN, Brazil's highest monetary body.
